description: Repeatedly stated 'Sunday June 29' when June 29 is Monday. June 28 is Sunday. Error propagated into session notes, protocol files (metrics-log.json, galen-protocols/SKILL.md), and the daily review. All references to the peptide stack start date need to be verified and corrected.
what_was_wrong: Peptide stack start date stated as 'Sunday June 29' throughout the session.
what_was_right: June 28 is Sunday. June 29 is Monday. David confirmed he will start on Sunday — correct date is June 28, 2026.
proposed_fix: Before stating any day-of-week + date combination, verify with: python3 -c "import datetime; print(datetime.date(2026,6,28).strftime('%A'))" or equivalent. Never assert a weekday from memory alone.
